name: Troyes

categories.label: VP tokens gained during play
categories.labelVi: Điểm VP đã nhận trong game
categories.hint: Total of VP tokens collected (hidden during play).

categories.label: Un-countered event cards with your presence
categories.labelVi: Thẻ sự kiện chưa bị đẩy lùi mà bạn có mặt
categories.hint: 1 VP per un-countered event card where you have cubes (incl. Marauding).

categories.label: VP on tradesman spaces (Activity cards)
categories.labelVi: VP ở ô thợ trên thẻ Hoạt động
categories.hint: Sum of VPs printed on the spaces occupied by your tradesmen.

categories.label: Cathedral levels with no cubes
categories.labelVi: Tầng nhà thờ chưa có khối của bạn
categories.hint: -2 VP for each of the 3 cathedral levels where you have no cubes.

categories.label: Chretien de Troyes: citizens on 3 principal buildings
categories.labelVi: Chrétien de Troyes: công dân ở 3 tòa nhà chính
categories.hint: Total citizens on the 3 principal buildings (Palace, Bishopric, City Hall). 3-4: 1, 5-6: 3, 7+: 6 VP; 2 players needs 4/6/8.

categories.label: Urbain IV: cubes on the Cathedral
categories.labelVi: Urbain IV: khối trên nhà thờ
categories.hint: Your cubes on the Cathedral. 3-4: 1, 5-6: 3, 7+: 6 VP; 2 players needs 4/6/8.

categories.label: Hugues de Payns: Influence points
categories.labelVi: Hugues de Payns: điểm Ảnh hưởng

categories.label: Le Florentin: tradesmen on Activity cards
categories.labelVi: Le Florentin: thợ trên thẻ Hoạt động
categories.hint: Your tradesmen on Activity cards. 2-3: 1, 4-5: 3, 6+: 6 VP.

categories.label: Henry I: Event cards gained
categories.labelVi: Henry I: thẻ sự kiện đã giành

notes: family: end-game-categories. Game ends at the end of the round in which the final red event card enters play. Only characters that are actually in the game score: every player scores on EACH character card in play (one per player, chosen secretly), so enter 0 for characters not in play. Thresholds shown for 3-4 players; 2-player thresholds for Chretien and Urbain are 4/6/8 (already in byPlayerCount). The rulebook states no tiebreaker. Expansions (Ladies of Troyes) not modelled.
